derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H6461 (פָּסַס);
def: the palm (of the hand, as being spread out)

occurrences.text: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
